title: When Agents Need to Consolidate Memories: What RRR Consolidation Explains, and What It Does Not Explain, in Conversation ESAA
abstract: arXiv:2611.15644v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language-model agents can share conversational history across sessions, but persistence does not guarantee retrieval of current decisions and their provenance. This engineering study presents Memory-TCG, a Conversation ESAA extension inspired by ringing, resonance and renormalization (RRR), and an exploratory synthetic evaluation comparing chronological retrieval, two simplified baselines (B, recency-aware, and B', authority-aware), full RRR, and variants under three output budgets. With 480 facts and 1,024 tokens, full RRR recalled 0.44 of current decisions, versus 0.06 for chronological retrieval and 0.58 for the oracle ceiling; with 4,096 tokens it recalled all of them. B' and the no-resonance variant matched full RRR in decision recall across all nine scale-budget combinations, as expected when the active decision set and the adapter ordering are the same. translated_title: 当智能体需要巩固记忆时：对话ESAA中RRR巩固机制能解释什么，又不能解释什么
translated_abstract: 语言模型智能体可以在多个会话之间共享对话历史，但持久化存储并不能保证当前决策及其来源信息能够被有效检索。本工程研究提出了Memory-TCG——一个受振铃、共振与重整化启发的对话ESAA扩展，并开展了一项探索性合成评估，在三种输出预算下比较按时间顺序检索、两个简化基线（B为基于新近度的基线，B'为基于权威度的基线）、完整RRR及其各变体的表现。在480条事实、1,024个token的设置下，完整RRR召回了44%的当前决策，而按时间顺序检索仅召回6%，预言机上限为58%；在4,096个token时，完整RRR召回了全部当前决策。在全部九种规模-预算组合中，B'基线与无共振变体在决策召回上与完整RRR持平，这在活跃决策集与适配器排序相同的情况下符合预期。振铃对决策的独立贡献未被单独测量：（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出受RRR（振铃、共振、重整化）启发的Memory-TCG记忆巩固机制，在有限token预算下将当前决策召回率从0.06大幅提升至0.44，但同时发现简化基线B'与无共振变体的表现与完整RRR持平，表明振铃机制的独立贡献尚未得到实证。
en_tdlr: This engineering study introduces Memory-TCG, an RRR-inspired memory consolidation extension for conversational agents, which substantially boosts recall of current decisions under limited token budgets (0.44 vs. 0.06 for chronological retrieval), yet finds that simplified baseline B' and the no-resonance variant match full RRR, leaving the isolated contribution of ringing unmeasured.
